description: Salt-bleached planks creak underfoot. Ropes coil like sleeping snakes. Gulls fight over fish heads at the tideline.
Stalls under sailcloth awnings. The smell hits before the sight does. Coin clinks under bartering voices.
A squat stone tower at the cove's western horn. The lamp above turns slowly, even in daylight. The door at the base is iron-bound.
